definition.secQuarterMethod: Direct quarterly facts or differences of cumulative facts with the same fiscal start; zero differences retained
definition.fxMethod: Primary non-USD facts use quarterly average FX; published historical supplements retain source USD conversion
definition.capex: Cash capital spending on property, plant, equipment and disclosed capitalized software/intangibles; positive spending; excludes business acquisitions and noncash financing leases; provider classifications may differ
definition.missing: null; annual and TTM require four complete quarters
